exposure: adhesions in the upper region of the abdominal cavity
adhesions in the middle region of the abdominal cavity
adhesions in the lower region of the abdominal cavity
outcome: presence and severity of abdominal or pelvic adhesions
cohort: 104 women who had undergone at least one previous cesarean section and were scheduled for laparoscopic surgery due to benign gynaecologic indications
finding: The skin scar characteristics of the previous caesarean section are associated with the presence and severity of pelvic and abdominal adhesions.
